title: The Gospel Dispensations
traveler_why: Scout looks across the whole story of the world and sees the same pattern every time: people forget, and Heavenly Father sends the gospel back.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because Scout loves to look across a whole big story and spot the same pattern every time. In Scout’s world today: Scout found an old photo album at Grandma’s house. On every page, in every year, there was the same thing — someone holding a baby, someone helping, someone smiling. “Look and see!” Scout said. “It’s the same love on every page!” Just like Heavenly Father sent the gospel back again and again in every age, Scout learned that some things never change, no matter how many years go by.
